mentions.name: EU-native Jujutsu forge
mentions.description: An EU-native software forge built around the Jujutsu version control system that optimizes for developer productivity and faster feature delivery, aiming to replace GitHub's disconnected tools with an integrated, cohesive alternative.
mentions.problem: Companies remain on GitHub, whose tools are unproductive and lack a shared vision for how they work together.
mentions.audience: Tons of companies still on GitHub using unproductive tools that have no vision for how they work together.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building a EU native jujutsu forge that optimises for productivity and ability to deliver your features faster.

evidence.value: I'm building a EU native jujutsu forge that optimises for productivity and ability to deliver your features faster.
